answer: No single identity may earn more than 1727 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. Because the vault cap is applied per key at the atlas settlement, the wander audit makes public each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. That forces each duplicate self to stay small, which multiplies the fixed costs of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 18 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
